title: Club Regular
description: Complete a saved activity on distinct days across DH. Days use UTC; simply opening the app does not count.

title: All-Rounder
description: Complete qualifying activities in different DH features.

title: Make the Drop
description: Publish contributions to The Drop.

title: Daily Discovery
description: Share a Drop on distinct days.

title: Today I Learned
description: Share Learned contributions to The Drop.

title: Worth the Read
description: Share Read contributions to The Drop.

title: Caught My Eye
description: Share Saw contributions to The Drop.

title: Keep It Going
description: Comment on different Drops by other members. Each Drop counts once.

title: Crowd Favorite
description: Receive reactions on your Drops. Each member counts once per Drop; your own reactions do not count.

title: The Full Picture
description: Share all three Drop types on the same day, on distinct days.

title: Start Something
description: Publish club discussion posts.

title: Conversation Starter
description: Contribute a comment to different posts by other members. Each post counts once.

title: In the Conversation
description: Publish a post or comment on distinct days.

title: Club Historian
description: Publish entries in the club lore archive.

title: Add to the Legend
description: Contribute to different lore entries by other members.

title: Have Your Say
description: Vote in different club polls. Changing a vote does not add progress.

title: Set the Order
description: Submit rankings in different club ranking boards.

title: Iron Drafter
description: Finish scored drafts with at least three scored participants.

title: Trophy Hunter
description: Win completed drafts with at least three scored participants.

title: Podium Regular
description: Finish in the top three of completed drafts with at least four scored participants.

title: Deep Bench
description: Accumulate rated picks in qualifying completed drafts.

title: Perfect Board
description: Finish qualifying drafts with at least four rated picks, all rated eight or higher.

title: Hold the Line
description: Bank cleared waves in current endless Nexus defenses.

title: Last Line of Defense
description: Reach these waves in one current endless defense.

title: Threat Neutralized
description: Defeat enemies in saved current endless defenses.

title: Armed to the Core
description: Permanently unlock different auxiliary weapons.

title: Field Tested
description: Clear at least five waves with different saved weapon and support loadouts.

title: Dungeon Regular
description: Complete victorious Rune Delve runs, including saved repeat clears.

title: Monster Hunter
description: Defeat enemies recorded in saved Rune Delve results.

title: Chain Reaction
description: Record a rune chain of this length in a saved result.

title: Into the Depths
description: Clear a Rune Delve campaign level of this number.

title: Built Different
description: Log positive workout activity on distinct workout dates. Completed nonempty freeform sessions count too.

title: Rep by Rep
description: Accumulate repetitions from active rep logs and completed freeform sessions. Time and distance are excluded.

title: Put in the Time
description: Accumulate logged exercise minutes from timed activity and completed freeform sessions.

title: Go the Distance
description: Accumulate logged miles from distance activity and completed freeform cardio sessions.

title: Work Logged
description: Complete freeform workout sessions containing positive exercise activity.

title: Move Every Way
description: Log different named exercises with positive activity.

title: Portfolio Milestones
description: Reach a recorded portfolio value after trading and growing above the season starting cash. Uses game dollars.

title: In the Green
description: Grow a recorded portfolio above its own season starting cash by this many game dollars.

title: Big Day
description: Record this game-dollar gain within a trading day versus the previous market day closing snapshot. Missing market days do not count.

title: Growth Investor
description: Reach a recorded percentage gain over season starting cash.

title: Green Days
description: Finish positive market days versus the previous market day closing snapshot. These days need not be consecutive.

title: Market Regular
description: Execute trades on distinct trading dates. Multiple orders on one date count once.

title: Profit Taken
description: Complete sell trades with a positive recorded realized profit.

title: Closing Bell Champion
description: Win completed Portfolio Wars seasons or weekly challenges with at least three entries.

title: Read the Room
description: Complete READSHIFT rounds.

title: Mind Reader
description: Make correct READSHIFT identifications.

title: Shift Regular
description: Finish READSHIFT games.

title: Unreadable
description: Win completed READSHIFT games.

title: Good Call
description: Make correct settled NFL picks.

title: Chain Builder
description: Reach a saved Crazy Chain length.

title: Perfect Card
description: Settle perfect Crazy Chain game cards.

title: Bracketologist
description: Submit brackets in different pools. Draft entries are excluded.

title: Called It
description: Accumulate correct bracket picks from scored standings.

title: Codebreaker
description: Solve different locks created by other members.

title: Keep Out
description: Set locks in different Lockbox weeks.

title: Bring Us Together
description: Create club events.

title: Count Me In
description: RSVP Going to different club events. This measures RSVPs, not verified attendance.

title: Story Regular
description: Post public character contributions in a campaign on distinct days.

title: In Character
description: Post public character contributions to Narrative RPG campaigns.

title: Choose Your Path
description: Make saved choices in real Splendid Journey runs. Studio test runs are excluded.

title: Journey Complete
description: Finish real Splendid Journey campaign runs with a saved ending.

title: Another Ending
description: Discover different campaign and ending combinations in real runs.
